finalText:
I made the headlines bigger on four of the five Onboarding artboards. The Team hub artboard is unchanged because another of your AI runs is working on it right now.

- **What changed:** the headlines on Welcome, GitHub door, Local folder and You're in went from 34px to 40px. On the first three I also raised the line height from 34px to 44px so the bigger text has room. The canvas check passed. I looked at a screenshot of each of the four artboards: each headline still fits on one line, nothing overlaps, and the layout holds.
- **Not quite "one step":** 34px is already the largest size in the maude type scale, so there's no next size to move to. I used 40px, which keeps roughly the same ratio between sizes as the rest of the scale. It's a fixed size set on each headline, not one of the system's named sizes. If you want it to be one, the maude system needs a new, larger size.
- **Team hub:** that artboard's headline is still 34px. All four wizard headlines share one style rule, and changing it would also change the artboard the other run is working on. That's why I set the size on each headline instead. When that run finishes, ask me again and I'll give its headline the same 40px. After that, the four 40px settings could be folded back into the shared style rule.
